Do deep research on global lithium supply chain risks. Global lithium supply chains face concentration risk, with a small number of countries accounting for the majority of both mining and refining capacity. Chile, Australia, and China dominate different stages of the pipeline, and geopolitical tensions or export restrictions in any of these regions could disrupt battery manufacturing worldwide. Recycling capacity is growing but still represents a small fraction of total supply, meaning primary extraction will remain the dominant source for at least the next decade even as demand accelerates alongside electric vehicle adoption targets set by major economies.
